info.name: Temporal Card Issuance
info.description: Milestones 1 to 3. Start Temporal, mocks, worker and API, then run this collection in the Collection Runner, deselecting folder 9. Polling requests repeat once a second until the workflow is ready. A full run takes about 2 minutes.

item.name: 9 Manual (deselect in the Runner)
item.description: These need you to stop and restart the worker, so run them one at a time with Send. Each request description says what to do.

item.name: tc15 Create card while the worker is stopped

exec: pm.test('503 while the worker is down, or ACTIVE after restart', () => pm.expect([503, 200]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Stop the worker (Ctrl+C) before "Create card". Send this: expect 503 PROGRESS_UNAVAILABLE. Restart the worker, wait a few seconds, send again: expect ACTIVE.

item.name: M3-13 Slow processor listing (1.5 s per page)
M3-13 Start reconciliation, one card per page

request.description: About 5 seconds after sending, stop the worker (Ctrl+C), then start it again.
Send until COMPLETED. Then in the Web UI, open reconcile-bank-a-<run>-m3-13: the Reconcile activity completed on attempt 2.
